author: Refuses
body:
I bought this account by my friend for 30 Usd $ and turns out that i am banned from avicus...  i had never logged in into avicus before and my friend Online4Fun wants me to play with him nebula so when i logged in , turns out i had been banned last year 3 am (for me) august 25... so i wish that i could be unbanned and i want to play nebula as my friend said its one of the best servers that has this kind of gamemode..


Faithfully,
Refuses
